rng.seed_provenance: Process-constructor seed; actual course spawn state UNKNOWN; shared with other systems

spawn.gate: both resolved list pointers; free pool; nonempty FlightList
spawn.trigger: u=U(0.1,1); clock+=0.003; trigger if u<clock*0.1; reset clock even if later gate fails
spawn.selection: nearest XZ; first full list, then [previous-5,previous+5) clipped; add R(0,3), clamp; cache base
spawn.origin: All entities in one selected burst receive same marker XYZ; queued at manager+68
spawn.activation: 1affe0 activates at most one pending entity per manager invocation

flight.write: entity+50 en3d translation +50/+54/+58/+5c; 1b0508 mirrors to entity+4c en2d

flock: Independent controllers, shared burst origin. No neighbor steering or shared spline in traced path
retirement: 1b01f8/1b0238 horizontal distance > MaxFlyDist^2 from first registry entry; equality retained; return to free pool
animation: Separate owner slot1; keys0..2, advance on fifth invocation; ground key3
precision: FLOAT32_RECONSTRUCTION; no PS2 FPU bit-exactness claim
